summary: Read Top, New, Ask, and Show stories with complete comment threads.
release_notes: Read a story's article on the reader, keep it after the front page has moved on, and see at a glance which stories have been read.
user: Somebody who follows Hacker News and wants it on e-ink.
job: Read Top, New, Ask and Show stories with complete comment threads.
offline: Only your marks survive without the network; the stories themselves need it.

data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; they are your place in the discussion

capabilities_required.name: network
capabilities_required.purpose: to fetch stories and comments from Hacker News

non_goals: It does not post or vote.
It does not cache whole threads for offline reading.
